_comment: LEVEL 5 (stack): a complete chat/assistant app in ONE call — L3 features (auth, rate-limit, SSE streaming, notifications, uploads) + L4 components (layout, login, chat, markdown viewer, code block, page, dropzone) pre-wired, plus CI/gate/deploy. No new code: pure composition.
name: stack-chat
description: Complete chat/assistant app: FastAPI backend (JWT auth + rate limiting + SSE streaming + notifications + uploads) + React frontend (login, chat UI with markdown/code rendering). One call = full chat product skeleton.

variables.name: project_name
variables.description: Python package name, e.g. 'demo_chat' (drives all nested packages)

notes: Chat product starter. Backend: set JWT_SECRET in .env, include ALL routers (auth, sse, notifications, upload) in {{ project_name }}/main.py, make sure models are imported, replace the SSE heartbeat TODO with your real event generator (queue -> yield 'data: {json}'). Frontend: npm install, wire the login flow, then: <Chat messages={msgs} onSend={async (t) => { const reply = await api('/api/chat', {method:'POST', body:{message:t}}); setMsgs([...msgs, {id:2, role:'assistant', content: reply.text}]); }} streamingText={partial} /> — render assistant bubbles with <MarkdownViewer text={...}/> instead of plain text for rich answers. SSE note: EventSource can't set headers — protect /api/stream with a short-lived query token. Rate limits: add dependencies=[Depends(rate_limit('10/minute', key=user_key))] to chat endpoints. CI, security gate, docker and nginx come pre-configured.
